concerns.text: FR-023 (state file hash update upon changes to synthetic generator or windowing logic) has NO implementing task. The coverage list omits it entirely, and plan Task 4.4 exists but was never carried into tasks.md. Dropped requirement.

T107's sensitivity_report.csv columns (fp_rate, fn_rate, instability_flag) contradict the contract schema (false_positive_rate, false_negative_rate, stability_flag) and omit the schema-required f1_score. A task whose deliverable cannot validate against its own contract is a constraint violation.
FR-024 mandates validation of config.yaml against 'anomaly_detector.schema.yaml'; T101 validates against 'config.schema.yaml' instead. The task silently narrows the spec's named contract.

Constitution: 'All benchmark datasets MUST be fetched from the UCI Machine Learning Repository.' T104 instructs fetching NAB raw GitHub URLs and/or ucimlrepo. The task institutionalizes a constitution violation; reconcile (amend constitution or re-scope) rather than tasking the violation.

Principle VII requires varying the Dirichlet process concentration prior in a sensitivity analysis. No task (C10, T107) sweeps the concentration prior; T107 only sweeps detection thresholds and window size. Constitution violation introduced by omission.

SC-001 quantifies signature distinctness as Cohen's d ≥ 0.5, but no task computes Cohen's d (T106 lists only KS/Wilcoxon/t-test/bootstrap). The SC coverage section claims SC-001 is covered by T106 — it is not.

US-1 Scenario 3 requires incremental posterior updates ('updated without full retraining') with <4h runtime; no task implements or verifies incremental updating. Either add a task or the spec scenario is silently dropped.

Spec requires the final report to include the Cohen (1988) threshold justification and the observed FP-rate range across the sweep; T111's final_report.md description mentions neither. Extend T111's verification to include both elements.

Constitution requires checksums recorded in the state file's artifact_hashes map; T101 forbids writing to state/ and T104 records checksums in data/processed/results/data_checksums.json. Note constitution Principle III also says 'recorded under data/' — the constitution is internally inconsistent; tasks should state which clause is authoritative rather than silently picking one.
